capabilities: Keep an auto-saving scratch page and save it as a note or append it to the daily note
Record and reuse a clipboard history across apps, with search, pinning and insertion
Collect selected text from any note via the right-click menu
Show and control Timebox sessions with a live timer, totals and history
Customize accent, background and text colors and show or hide tabs
disambiguation: Not a general text editor; it is a small scratch page plus clipboard and session panels for the sidebar.
extras: Makes no network requests and stores all data in the vault's plugin data.json; clipboard history is plain text and travels with a synced vault. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or newer. On Flatpak installs, a manual sandbox permission step is needed for the KDE clipboard history.
problem: The sidebar space under the Calendar is usually empty, and quick thoughts, copied text and tracked work sessions have no single home inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Timebox is a companion plugin: it tracks study and work sessions inside your notes.
Add to today's daily note uses the folder, date format and template of the Daily notes core plugin

summary: Tabbed sidebar panel with a scratch page, clipboard history, and a Timebox session overview, sitting under the Calendar in the right sidebar.
